  465:    * Callback for tool execution completion. Logs as `type: "tool_result"` on success
  466:    * or `type: "tool_error"` on failure.
  467:    *
  468:    * @param name - The tool name
  469:    * @param isError - Whether the tool execution resulted in an error
  470:    * @param result - Optional result value. Downstream storage may clip very
  471:    * large tool payloads to keep dashboard log views responsive.
  472:    */
  473:   onToolEnd(name: string, isError: boolean, result?: unknown): void {
  474:     const type = isError ? "tool_error" : "tool_result";
  475:     const detail = summarizeToolResultDetail(result);
  476:     const startedAt = this.shiftToolStart(name);
  477:     const durationMs = startedAt !== undefined ? Math.max(0, Date.now() - startedAt) : undefined;
  478:     this.writeEntry(name, type, detail, `Failed to log tool end "${name}" (${type}) for ${this.taskId}`, false, durationMs !== undefined ? { durationMs }
  479:     // Record completion as tool_result/tool_error with a duration descriptor.

## 8. The single conversion every tool-result text goes through (base revision)
$ egit show <base>:packages/pi-claude-cli/src/prompt-builder.ts | lines 566-586
  566:  * Converts tool result content to text.
  567:  * Handles string content and array of content blocks.
  568:  * Image blocks get placeholder text (actual image passthrough handled separately).
  569:  */
  570: function toolResultContentToText(content: string | unknown[]): string {
  571:   if (typeof content === "string") return content;
  572:   if (!Array.isArray(content)) return "";
  573: 
  574:   const texts: string[] = [];
  575:   for (const rawBlock of content) {
  576:     const block = rawBlock as Record<string, unknown>;
  577:     if (block.type === "text") {
  578:       texts.push(typeof block.text === "string" ? block.text : "");
  579:     } else if (block.type === "image") {
  580:       texts.push("[An image was shared here but could not be included]");
  581:       placeholderImageCount++;
  582:     }
  583:   }
  584:   return texts.join("\n");
  585: }
